summary:
Amedspor travel to face Kasimpasa in round four of the Super Lig. Amedspor enters this match as the outsider with a 31% chance of victory, while Kasimpasa is viewed as a slight favourite two days before kickoff.

Kasimpasa are eighth in the league with five points, recording one win and two draws in their three matches to date. In their last league match, they drew 1-1 away at Basaksehir.

Amedspor are fifth in the league with six points, having secured two wins and one loss in their three matches to date. In their last league match, the team recorded a 2-1 win at home against Trabzonspor.

This will be the first-ever meeting between these two teams.

Kasimpasa enters the match with Adrian Benedyczak, who has two goals and one assist at an average rating of 7.0, and Claudio Winck, who has one assist.

Amedspor features Dia Saba, who has two goals at an average rating of 7.4, and Gift Orban, who has one goal and one assist. Yira Sor is out with an injury, and David Bates is sidelined with an injury.

Eyupspor are 14th in the league with three points. They have one win and two losses in their three matches to date, coming off a 2-1 home win against Alanyaspor in their last league match.

Corum FK has a record of one win and one loss over their last two matches against Eyupspor. The two teams meet for the first time since March 2024, when Corum FK won 1-0 away.

Genclerbirligi is second in the league with seven points. They have recorded two wins and one draw in their three matches to date, following a 1-1 draw at home against Erzurumspor FK in their last league match.

Trabzonspor has recorded three wins and two losses across their last five meetings with Genclerbirligi, a sequence featuring an average of 3.6 goals per meeting. In the most recent encounter between these two sides last season, Genclerbirligi won 3-0 away.
